workouts.title: METCON
workouts.description:
9 Sets of :20 Work / :10 Rest At Each Station *

* Take :30 to transition between stations

Station 1:
Double Under

Station 2:
Goblet Lunge @ 53/35lbs

Station 3:
Cal Fan Bike

Station 4:
Burpee to 6" Target

NOTES:
- Work at a high intensity on each set! The goal here is all about developing fitness with short bursts of high intensity and familiar movements
- For the fan bike, count each calorie as a "rep."
- Work for all nine sets at each station before transitioning to the next station, resting for :30 between stations.
- For the burpees to target, use any target 6" above your fingertips when the arms are extended overhead.

workouts.title: Strict Pull-Up
workouts.description:
OPTION A:

Band Assisted Strict Pull-Up
4x20, 1:00 Rests

NOTES:
- This option is for those who either have strict pull-ups but are not ready to load them, or for people who do not have strict pull-ups and will need to use a band.
- Use as little band tension as possible.
----

OPTION B:

Weighted Strict Pull-Up
6x6 @ 5RM Weight.
Rest At Least 1:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Last week of adding one rep.
- Make sure that you perform each rep as explosively as possible.
- If you did not do the 5RM, aim for a load that feels like an RPE 8+.
